description: Odisha has five semiconductor projects in the pipeline with proposed investments exceeding $4 billion. These initiatives aim to establish a semiconductor and advanced electronics ecosystem, including AI data centres and a sovereign AI hub.
body_lead: Odisha has five semiconductor projects in the pipeline, involving proposed investments exceeding $4 billion, as the state works to establish a foothold in global chip manufacturing and advanced electronics. These projects, which include semiconductor fabrication and advanced 3D chip packaging, are intended to shift Odisha's industrial landscape from mining and metals.India Semiconductor Mission are in Odisha. India's first compound semiconductor fabrication unit and first advanced 3D chip packaging unit are being built rapidly in the state.Intel and 3D Glass Solutions.
